_comment: EPISODE 4, TAKE A. The user compared all three episodes and picked EPISODE 2 as the bar: its grading, its cast and its NATURALNESS. Episode 3 lost the naturalness because removing the handling made people hold the can at arm's length like a product shot. So the looking is back, as its own beat after a hard cut: the interviewer passes the can and the person takes it, then the person GLANCES DOWN at the label and back up while the can stays upright, base down, chest height, label square to the lens. Eyes and head, not hands -- the fused 'takes it and looks at it' is what caused four defects on seed 4827 and it is not coming back. NEW in this episode: one_mic, because episode 2 put a second handheld microphone in a subject's hand at 7.5s and a dark object at a chest at 21s, and no clause had ever said how many microphones exist.

product._state_comment: can_sealed is OFF. Two takes proved the clause does not render. The mechanism is that the LID IS NEVER IN SHOT: the can stays vertical and square, so only the thin top rim is ever visible and the state cannot be read. The new glance beat is eyes and head only, so it does not tip the can and does not put the lid in view.
product.opening_extra: and no ring pull is touched

_shots_comment: EIGHT shots, two per person, unchanged from 4827. EVERY REACTION IS FACIAL. There is no 'turns it over', no 'sniffs it', no 'squints at it' aimed at the can, no 'reads the label' -- because each of those is an instruction to lift and rotate the product, and that is the defect this take exists to remove.
